body: Built from scratch, no existing anchor -- same discipline as Loki's 'who isn't here' treatment. Grounded in real Welsh legend: Cantre'r Gwaelod (drowned kingdom, Cardigan Bay) and Seithenyn, the sea-gate guardian who was drinking during the storm. Appended to the same later-addition block as MnM (#114). Commit b001297.
title: Drowned Prince lore entry, #115 (S170-93)
